description: Search Florida's Division of Corporations (Sunbiz) registry.

entityStatus.description: Only emit entities with this status. Determined from each entity's detail page.
entityStatus.title: Filter by entity status

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Each record requires a detail-page fetch, so keep this modest for large name/zip/address searches.
maxItems.title: Max items

proxyConfiguration.description: Only used as an automatic fallback if Sunbiz starts blocking datacenter requests. Leave default.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchTerm.description: The value to search for (entity name, officer/agent name, FEI/EIN digits, document number, ZIP code, street address, trademark name, or trademark owner name depending on `searchType`). Sunbiz performs a starts-with / nearest-alphabetical (or nearest-numerical, for FEI/ZIP) match on every search type EXCEPT `documentNumber`, same as the official site — a term with no exact match returns the closest neighbors in Sunbiz's index rather than zero results. Only `documentNumber` is a true exact-match lookup.
searchTerm.title: Search term

searchType.description: Which Sunbiz search axis to use.
searchType.title: Search type
